attributes.title: LYSS - how to read this dashboard
attributes.visState:
{"aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 11, "markdown": "**LYSS - Switch security** (last 7 days, refreshed every 5 minutes)

* **Failed controls**: each scan reports every control a switch fails (Level 1 Baseline failures are rule level 7, Level 2 Hardened failures level 5).
* **Regressions**: a control that passed at the previous scan fails now, so the configuration changed. Investigate them first.
* **NIST SP 800-53**: the same findings appear in Wazuh's NIST 800-53 compliance dashboard.

Evidence and fixes for each finding: open the switch in LYSS. Specification: [lyss.dev](https://lyss.dev)", "openLinksInNewTab": true}, "title": "LYSS - how to read this dashboard", "type": "markdown"}
